description: This file defines utilities and classes for integrating OneDNN (formerly MKL-DNN) with PyTorch's quantized operations, including cache management, weight packing, and post-operation attribute creation.

classes.name: PrimitiveCache
classes.description: Base class for caching primitive configurations based on input parameters.

classes.name: LinearPrimitiveCache
classes.description: Cache for linear (matmul) primitives with support for dynamic scale and zero point.

classes.name: PackedLinearWeightsOnednn
classes.description: Encapsulates packed weights for linear layers with methods for applying quantized operations.

classes.name: PackedConvWeightsOnednn
classes.description: Encapsulates packed weights for convolution layers with methods for applying quantized operations.

classes.name: QlinearForwardParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for executing a quantized linear (matmul) operation with OneDNN.

methods.name: hit
methods.description: Checks if the cache key matches the provided key.

methods.name: get_param
methods.description: Returns the stored linear parameters.

methods.name: get_params
methods.description: Returns the stored convolution parameters.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Returns the cache object for the primitive.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies the quantized linear transformation to input tensor.

methods.name: apply_relu
methods.description: Applies the quantized linear transformation with ReLU activation.

methods.name: apply_dynamic
methods.description: Applies dynamic quantized linear transformation.

methods.name: apply_dynamic_relu
methods.description: Applies dynamic quantized linear with ReLU.

methods.name: apply_leaky_relu
methods.description: Applies leaky ReLU to the quantized weights.

methods.name: apply_tanh
methods.description: Applies tanh activation to the quantized weights.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks the packed weights into original tensors.

methods.name: prepack
methods.description: Prepares and packs weights for quantized linear layer.

methods.name: apply_impl
methods.description: Implementation detail for applying fused post-ops.

methods.name: apply_dynamic_impl
methods.description: Implementation detail for dynamic quantized application.

methods.name: get_conv_cache
methods.description: Returns the cache for convolution primitives.

methods.name: get_deconv_cache
methods.description: Returns the cache for deconvolution primitives.

methods.name: create_attr_by_post_op
methods.description: Creates OneDNN attributes for post-operations based on parameters.

methods.name: is_weight_symmetric_quant
methods.description: Checks if the weight tensor uses symmetric quantization.

methods.name: should_use_onednn_quant
methods.description: Decides whether to use OneDNN quantized kernel over FBGEMM based on heuristics.

methods.name: _qconv_prepack_onednn
methods.description: Prepares and packs convolution weights for quantized execution with OneDNN.
